note: cost of reaching a fixed accuracy on the supernova shock, against front width; produced by notebooks/gen_shock_cost.py
timing_note: seconds is one whole cumulative call, which returns n_baselines probabilities; divide by n_baselines for the per-probability time the paper quotes
front_note: each order appears twice: "declared" passes the two front edges, "resolved" also cuts the front interior, which a uniform n_slabs grid never reaches
reference_note: slab counts scored against shock_reference.json, frozen at rtol 1e-14; every target sits at least two decades above the reference own self-convergence
